title: 三人行

lines.text: 九月十号是中国的教师节。那天晚上上课以前，同学们给李老师送了一束鲜花和一张贺卡。
lines.py: jiǔ yuè shí hào shì Zhōng guó de jiào shī jié. nà tiān wǎn shang shàng kè yǐ qián, tóng xué men gěi Lǐ lǎo shī sòng le yí shù xiān huā hé yì zhāng hè kǎ.
lines.en: The tenth of September is Teachers' Day in China. That evening, before class, the students give Teacher Li a bunch of flowers and a card.

lines.text: 李老师抱着花，笑着说：“谢谢大家。孔子说过：‘三人行，必有我师。’教过你们本领的人，都是你们的老师。”
lines.py: Lǐ lǎo shī bào zhe huā, xiào zhe shuō: “xiè xie dà jiā. kǒng zi shuō guò: ‘sān rén xíng, bì yǒu wǒ shī. ’ jiāo guò nǐ men běn lǐng de rén, dōu shì nǐ men de lǎo shī.”
lines.en: Holding the flowers, Teacher Li smiles. "Thank you, everyone. Confucius said that when three people walk together, one of them can always be your teacher. Anyone who has taught you something is your teacher."

lines.text: 睡觉以前，他给李老师发了一条消息：“李老师，您说得对，三人行，必有我师。”
lines.py: shuì jiào yǐ qián, tā gěi Lǐ lǎo shī fā le yì tiáo xiāo xi: “Lǐ lǎo shī, nín shuō de duì, sān rén xíng, bì yǒu wǒ shī.”
lines.en: Before going to bed, he sends Teacher Li a message: "Teacher Li, you were right. When three people walk together, one of them is always my teacher."
